questions.question_text: Rohan visits the market. He buys a notebook for ₹10 and a pencil for ₹5. How much money did he spend in total? If he gave a ₹20 note to the shopkeeper, how much money will he get back?
questions.answer: Step 1: Total money spent = ₹10 + ₹5 = ₹15. Step 2: Money he will get back = ₹20 - ₹15 = ₹5. Rohan will get ₹5 back.

questions.question_text: Look at the toy data in Lina's room: Cars (4), Dolls (6), Teddy Bears (3). Which toy does Lina have the most of? How many toys does she have in total?
questions.answer: Step 1: The highest number is 6, so Lina has the most Dolls. Step 2: Total toys = 4 (Cars) + 6 (Dolls) + 3 (Teddy Bears) = 13 toys in total.
